name: How to Extract Pages from a PDF
description: Pull specific pages from a PDF into a new file — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Enter the pages to extract
step.text: Type a page range like 1,3-5,8 to extract individual pages or ranges from the document.

step.name: Download the extracted pages
step.text: Click 'Extract Pages'. The selected pages are packaged into a new PDF and download immediately.
